verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents genuine two-way Slack integration: incidents can be created, acknowledged and resolved from Slack, with events synced to the dashboard. Teams is documented for alerts and for invoking the AI SRE, and GitHub only for one-way AI-suggested fix pull requests. Ticketing is shown with Linear rather than Jira. Missing for 10: any Jira integration, any Zoom integration, bidirectional state sync for Teams and GitHub, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways

citations.quote: Create, acknowledge and resolve incidents directly from Slack. We automatically sync all events between Slack and the Better Stack dashboard.
As well as SMS, e-mail, Slack, Teams, and push notifications
Call the AI SRE from Slack, MS Teams, or your existing LLM workflows.
Got an exception? Get a pull request with a suggested fix waiting for you in GitHub.
